name: Romans
lede: The forty-fifth book of the Bible, in full: Paul's letter to the saints at Rome, written at Corinth and carried by Phoebe — the gospel the power of God unto salvation, all under sin and justified freely by his grace, Abraham's faith reckoned for righteousness, the free gift in Christ, no condemnation and nothing able to separate us from the love of God, Israel and the olive tree, a living sacrifice, and the greetings, every word in the words of the ASV.

books.name: The Power of God unto Salvation
books.blurb: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, to all that are in Rome — the letter written at Corinth by lamplight and given to Phoebe; I long to see you; I am not ashamed of the gospel: for it is the power of God unto salvation; the invisible things of him clearly seen; they changed the glory of the incorruptible God for an image; thou art without excuse, O man, whosoever thou art that judgest; the law written in their hearts; there is none righteous, no, not one; for all have sinned, and fall short of the glory of God; being justified freely by his grace.

books.name: Justified by Faith
books.blurb: Abraham believed God, and it was reckoned unto him for righteousness — look toward heaven: so shall thy seed be; who in hope believed against hope; being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God; while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us; through one man sin entered into the world, and where sin abounded, grace did abound more exceedingly; buried with him through baptism, to walk in newness of life; the wages of sin is death; Thou shalt not covet; wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me out of the body of this death? I thank God through Jesus Christ our Lord.

books.name: No Condemnation
books.blurb: There is therefore now no condemnation to them that are in Christ Jesus; the mind of the Spirit is life and peace; ye received the spirit of adoption, whereby we cry, Abba, Father; the whole creation groaneth and travaileth in pain together until now; the Spirit himself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered; to them that love God all things work together for good; if God is for us, who is against us?; who shall separate us from the love of Christ?; neither height, nor depth, nor any other creature.

books.name: The Depth of the Riches
books.blurb: Great sorrow and unceasing pain for my brethren; in Isaac shall thy seed be called; I will have mercy on whom I have mercy; hath not the potter a right over the clay?; a stone of stumbling laid in Zion; the word is nigh thee, in thy mouth, and in thy heart; how beautiful are the feet of them that bring glad tidings of good things!; Elijah and the seven thousand who have not bowed the knee to Baal; the olive tree, its broken branches and the wild olive grafted in; and so all Israel shall be saved; O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and the knowledge of God!

books.name: A Living Sacrifice
books.blurb: Present your bodies a living sacrifice, and be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind; many members in one body; heap coals of fire upon his head; the powers that be are ordained of God; love is the fulfilment of the law; the night is far spent, put on the armor of light; the weak and the strong, herbs and meat; every knee shall bow; the root of Jesse; from Jerusalem round about unto Illyricum, and on by Rome unto Spain; Phoebe commended, and the greetings — Prisca and Aquila, Epænetus, Mary, Andronicus and Junias and all the saints; I Tertius, who write the epistle; to the only wise God, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory for ever. Amen.
